articles.title: Araújo walks off training with hamstring tightness, scan scheduled
articles.snippet: Ronald Araújo cut short Saturday's session after feeling hamstring tightness. Barcelona have scheduled a scan.
articles.full_text: Ronald Araújo cut short Saturday morning's session at the Ciutat Esportiva after feeling hamstring tightness in his right leg. Club medical staff treated him on the grass and he did not return to the group. A scan is scheduled for Sunday. The centre-back is an injury doubt for Monday's match; teammates described the issue as a twinge rather than a rupture, but he is not fully fit. Manager's staff will wait for imaging before deciding whether he is in contention.

articles.title: Olmo still not fully fit after muscle injury — ruled out of next squad
articles.snippet: Dani Olmo remains sidelined. Barcelona have ruled out the attacking midfielder after a muscle injury.
articles.full_text: Dani Olmo remains not fully fit following last week's muscle injury. Barcelona have ruled out the Spain international from the next matchday squad as a precaution. He has begun individual physio work but has not joined full training. Internally the view is that rushing him would be a risk after he was previously sidelined for several weeks.

articles.title: Gavi's workload in focus as staff discuss minutes management
articles.snippet: Coaching staff want Gavi's minutes managed after signs of fatigue in midweek.

articles.title: Yamal attends fashion gala, pictured leaving evening event after midnight
articles.snippet: Lamine Yamal was at a brand gala in Barcelona on Friday night.
articles.full_text: Lamine Yamal attended a fashion gala in the city on Friday, an evening event for a kit partner. Photographers pictured the winger leaving the launch party shortly after midnight. There is no suggestion of a nightclub or drinking; it was a scheduled brand appearance. Staff are monitoring his rest ahead of a compressed fixture list but he completed full training on Saturday and looked sharp.

articles.title: Balde photographed in VIP area of beach club — club say it was a family dinner
articles.snippet: Alejandro Balde was seen in the VIP area of a Barcelona beach club.
articles.full_text: Alejandro Balde was photographed in the VIP area of a beach club on Thursday evening. Tabloid reports framed it as nightlife. A club spokesperson said it was a family dinner that ended before 23:00, not a nightclub session. Balde trained fully the following morning. No alcohol incident has been alleged.

articles.title: Lewandowski given a night off as rotation options assessed
articles.snippet: Robert Lewandowski was rested from the last portion of training.
articles.full_text: Robert Lewandowski was given a night off from the evening tactical session as staff discussed rotation. The striker completed the morning unit and reported no issues. Ferran Torres is in contention if minutes are managed. Lewandowski said he is raring to go but accepted the need for recovery in a congested calendar.

articles.title: Pedri and de Jong available — full training, no issues
articles.snippet: Pedri and Frenkie de Jong came through training.
articles.full_text: Pedri completed full training and is available. Frenkie de Jong also came through training with no issues and is fit to start. The pair set the tempo in a positional rondo. Staff described both as sharp and in contention without any fitness test required.

articles.title: Koundé back from international duty after delayed flight
articles.snippet: Jules Koundé landed late after a delayed flight from France camp.
articles.full_text: Jules Koundé returned from international duty on a delayed flight, landing in the early hours. It was not a red-eye by design but the disruption cost him a night of rest. He joined the group for a reduced session on Friday and is expected to be available, with minutes management possible if heavy legs appear.

articles.title: Raphinha posts gym recovery session — nutrition staff sign off
articles.snippet: Raphinha shared a gym video and ate with the squad nutritionist.
articles.full_text: Raphinha posted on Instagram from the gym after a recovery session and later joined a squad dinner overseen by nutrition staff. No diet issues were flagged. He is available and in contention on the right or as an inside forward. Teammates said he looked sharp.

articles.title: Cubarsí: composed week, no flags, starts internally favoured
articles.snippet: Pau Cubarsí has had a quiet, professional week.
articles.full_text: Pau Cubarsí has trained every session, is available, and staff see no issues. The centre-back is in contention to start. There have been no off-field mentions in local press this week. He is raring to go after coming through training unmarked.

articles.title: Fermín López sharp in finishing unit, pushing for minutes
articles.snippet: Fermín López was sharp in the finishing unit.
articles.full_text: Fermín López looked sharp in an attacking unit and is in contention for a bench role at least. He came through training with no issues and is fit to start if the staff opt for rotation in midfield.

articles.title: Casadó continues as holding option with no fitness concerns
articles.snippet: Marc Casadó is available as the holding midfielder.
articles.full_text: Marc Casadó is available and completed full training. There are no issues around the defensive midfielder, who is in contention either to start or to sit as the first rotation in front of the defence.
